title: Admin loading fixes pass production build and regression checks
summary: Verified current-report-first loading, compact comparison totals, request recovery and reduced navigation badge traffic. Production rollout and mobile acceptance remain pending.

changes.detail: Bound current-report and comparison requests, handle HTTP/JSON/network errors with retry, cancel obsolete requests and preserve the current report when optional trends fail. Added eight-second deadlines to authentication/permissions HTTP reads without changing authorization.

Request compact comparison totals after current report renders. Use narrow database projections and eight-second query deadlines. Delay optional badge reads 1.5 seconds; refresh each minute and skip hidden tabs instead of rereading five lists on every route navigation.
Added runtime regressions and performance documentation; regenerated private source-library catalog during production build.

validation.name: Focused runtime regressions
validation.detail: 23 tests passed, zero failures: analytics loading, deadline/body abort, cancellation, retry, stale-response prevention, compact API totals and authorization; existing admin UI recovery, workspace permissions and storefront loading regressions.

validation.name: TypeScript and lint
validation.detail: Root TypeScript tsc --noEmit --incremental false passed. Focused Next lint completed successfully with existing img warnings, no lint errors.

validation.name: Production build
validation.detail: Network-enabled production build exited 0 and generated 249/249 static pages. Initial sandboxed attempt compiled but encountered network EACCES during page collection and was stopped; authorized retry completed. Existing repository lint warnings remain.

validation.name: History retention
validation.detail: All six change-history persistence/interaction/append tests passed; previous reports retained. Final manifest consistency check run after append.

validation.name: Live baseline and rollout
validation.detail: Public homepage single pre-deployment request returned HTTP 200, 53352 compressed bytes, 2.517833s first byte and 3.046213s total. No production deployment, authenticated live Analytics timing, physical-phone UI check or post-deployment performance comparison. Existing 5000-row analytics limits remain; badge freshness may lag a minute.
